Hon'ble Salil Kumar Rai,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.
1.
The present petition has been filed challenging the orders dated 13.09.2023 and 23.09.2023 passed by Food Safety Officer, Mathura, i.e. the respondent no. 3, suspending the license of the petitioner.
The orders have been passed u/s 32 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
2. The said orders u/s 32 (4) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 is appealable before the Commissioner of Food Safety.
